Test Case 2: Recommend Endpoint - Count

Input:
  - Endpoint: POST /v2/activities/recommend?task_description=Add%20REST%20endpoint&limit=3
  - Method: curl POST from devbob pod to backend service
  - Backend: http://metabob-rpc-api.metabob.svc.cluster.local:8080
  - Task description: "Add REST endpoint" (URL encoded)

Expected Output:
  - Recommendation count: exactly 3
  - Response format: {"recommendations": [...]}
  - Each recommendation has: variant_id, activity_id, selection_metadata

Validation:
  - Count recommendations in response JSON
  - Verify count == 3
  - PASS if exact match, FAIL otherwise
